messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED kai (on-call): latency spike 95th > 1.2s and 500s for prompt-route-experimental in us-west-2, rollout id rollout_2026_04_02_09
kai: seeing it in dashboards now, alerting SRE. tagging @alex-sre
alex-sre: joining. quick check — is this the new endpoint muxbridge that rolled at 09:00?
sam-eng: yes, rollout_2026_04_02_09 pushed the experimental muxbridge endpoint for prompt routing (10% canary)
maria-support: we have ~9 customers reporting elevated latency and 3 with 500s, CS reports one on-call customer complaint
liz-product: FYI a small enterprise customer reported degraded throughput on their integrations, looks related to the new route
alex-sre: gathering traces. initial sign: muxbridge is dropping KV cache references intermittently, causing large token regen and CPU spikes on select hosts
kai: impact scope? can we scope by region and model? any error codes?
alex-sre: errors 502/500 from muxbridge proxy, only for seq_len > 1024 and traffic through variant v-exp-02, approx 2% of global traffic but concentrated in us-west-2
sam-eng: can we flip the feature flag for muxbridge for the canary? kill-switch exists: ff.experiment.muxbridge
kai: prepare for oncall handoff if we need a wider rollback. I will attempt flag flip now.
deploy-bot: Received API request to toggle feature flag ff.experiment.muxbridge -> OFF for rollout_2026_04_02_09 by kai
deploy-bot: Feature flag ff.experiment.muxbridge set to OFF (scope: rollout_2026_04_02_09, propagation: immediate)
kai: confirming propagation: traffic to v-exp-02 is dropping to 0% on gateway metrics
alex-sre: host CPU & KV miss rates returning to baseline on affected nodes, initial latency SLOs improving
maria-support: telling customers we mitigated, asking for ETA on permanent fix
sam-eng: root cause looks like an incompatibility between muxbridge request batching and the kernel selection for seq lengths >1024 — will open a patch PR, but we need a formal rollback for the release plan
liz-product: timeline ask from customer: ETA for complete fix?
sam-eng: provisional: patch + canary in ~3 hours, full deploy after validation ~6 hours
kai: for now we keep kill-switch engaged and continue monitoring. I'll hand off to alex for postmortem / timeline updates.
alex-sre: taking over on-call. will coordinate RCA and schedule postmortem. tagging @maria-support for customer comms
maria-support: prepping message to affected customers: short note, we disabled the experimental route and traffic is restored; working on fix; will follow up with timeline
kai: handing off detailed notes to alex in PagerDuty. last check: any remaining 500s?
alex-sre: minimal residual 500s (~0.1%), likely draining; will monitor for 30m then update incident status
deploy-bot: Incident recorded: incident-2026-04-02-muxbridge-kill engaged by kai
sam-eng: PR https://git.internal/repo/1234 addressing kernel selection guard opened, marking as WIP. will add regression test for seq_len boundaries
liz-product: thanks team. can we plan a customer-facing postmortem doc after the RCA? include mitigation steps and timeline
alex-sre: yes — will own postmortem draft, will include telemetry, timeline, and action items (FF safety automation, additional canary checks)
maria-support: tagging support leads to follow up with the 9 reported customers, CSAT watch
kai: thanks everyone. leaving the thread; oncall handoff complete to alex-sre :white_check_mark:
alex-sre: closing note: keep ff off until the patch is validated. if anything changes ping me in here or page oncall
deploy-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring
